103c9042-d18b-4b7e-9530-9f66090af83c.title: d5_failover_sequence
103c9042-d18b-4b7e-9530-9f66090af83c.merged_content:
---
config:
  sequence:
    showSequenceNumbers: true
    actorMargin: 35
    width: 900
    messageSpacing: 35
  theme: neo
---
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Client as Client / API Caller
    participant Gateway as Ingress Gateway
    participant Control as control-01 (Leader)
    participant Scheduler as Scheduler Quorum
    participant DataPrimary as data-01 (Shard A Primary)
    participant Standby as data-03 (Shard A Standby)
    participant Storage as Shared WAL & Snapshots
    participant Telemetry as Telemetry Tier

    Client->>Gateway: Submit command envelope (HTTPS)
    Gateway->>Control: Forward /k0/command.submit
    Control->>Scheduler: Validate + request shard lease {tenant, space}
    Scheduler-->>Control: Lease granted → data-01
    Control->>DataPrimary: Dispatch command + QoS budget token
    DataPrimary->>Storage: Append WAL shard A & fsync
    DataPrimary->>Standby: Stream WAL delta (async apply)
    Standby-->>DataPrimary: Replication ack (lag < 30s)
    DataPrimary-->>Control: Commit ack + receipt payload
    Control-->>Client: 202 Accepted + receipt hash
    DataPrimary->>Telemetry: Emit metrics (fsync, backlog, replica lag)

    Note over DataPrimary: Healthy steady-state operations

    Telemetry->>Control: Alert - heartbeat missing (data-01)
    Control->>Scheduler: Revoke shard A lease + mark degraded
    Scheduler->>Standby: Promote standby, grant lease, enable writers
    Standby->>Storage: Replay WAL + verify receipts parity
    Standby-->>Scheduler: Promotion complete (lag cleared)
    Scheduler-->>Control: Lease update → data-03
    Control->>Gateway: Update routing table / shard map
    Gateway->>Client: Transparent retry routed to data-03
    Standby->>Telemetry: Emit promotion event + new health metrics
    Telemetry-->>Control: Clear alert, confirm topology healthy

    Note over Standby,Control: Command path resumes on promoted primary
